SELECT
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY
    rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    disbursed_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown
WHERE
    status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'

SELECT
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM
    main.payment_event
WHERE
    payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY
    amount DESC;

SELECT
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM
    main.person_profile pp
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    issued_on,
    expires_on
FROM
    main.payment_card
WHERE
    card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY
    issued_on ASC;

SELECT
    op.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM
    main.organization_profile op
JOIN
    main.party p ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    main.organization_unit ou ON op.registered_region = ou.region_code
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
ORDER BY
    op.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    o.org_unit_id,
    o.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM
    main.account a
JOIN
    main.organization_unit o ON a.org_unit_id = o.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    o.org_unit_id,
    o.unit_name
ORDER BY
    account_count DESC;

SELECT
    s.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(c.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement c
JOIN main.organization_profile o ON c.borrower_party_id = o.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector s ON o.industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY
    s.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.home_org_unit_id AS org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM main.party_relation pr
JOIN main.party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    p.home_org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    c.net_capital,
    c.risk_weighted_assets
FROM main.capital_snapshot c
JOIN main.institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY c.net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs(ABS(a.ledger_balance))), 2) AS deposit_balance_sum
FROM
    main.account a
JOIN
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    deposit_balance_sum DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM
    main.delinquency_snapshot ds
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY
    avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    cs.net_capital
ORDER BY
    exposure_ratio DESC;

WITH loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        op.industry_code,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_loans
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
    HAVING total_loans >= 20
)
SELECT
    is_.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    ls.total_loans AS loan_count,
    ls.npl_loans AS npl_count,
    ROUND(ls.npl_loans * 1.0 / ls.total_loans, 6) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_stats ls
JOIN main.industry_sector is_ ON ls.industry_code = is_.sector_code
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    borrower_party_id AS 客户编号,
    display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM
    credit_agreement
JOIN
    party ON credit_agreement.borrower_party_id = party.party_id
GROUP BY
    borrower_party_id,
    display_name
ORDER BY
    合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM
    wealth_product
GROUP BY
    risk_level
ORDER BY
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN
    main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM
    party p
    INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    total_contract_amount > 300000000
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM main.data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN main.institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS overdue_record_count
FROM main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN main.institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
  AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_record_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM
    main.capital_snapshot c
JOIN
    main.institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    dlq.loan_id,
    dlq.principal_overdue_days,
    rc.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot dlq
JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON dlq.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE dlq.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND dlq.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY dlq.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM
    main.provision_snapshot ps
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ps.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

WITH institution_payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount
    FROM main.payment_instruction pi
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
restricted_exit_payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS restricted_exit_amount
    FROM main.payment_instruction pi
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN main.industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
    WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(res.restricted_exit_amount, 0.0) AS 违规流入金额,
    ips.total_instruction_amount AS 指令金额合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(res.restricted_exit_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / ips.total_instruction_amount, 6) AS 占比
FROM main.institution i
JOIN institution_payment_stats ips ON i.institution_id = ips.institution_id
LEFT JOIN restricted_exit_payment_stats res ON i.institution_id = res.institution_id
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM
    party p
INNER JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
INNER JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
INNER JOIN
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    os.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca.target_industry_code AS target_industry_code,
    is_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector os ON op.industry_code = os.sector_code
LEFT JOIN main.industry_sector is_target ON ca.target_industry_code = is_target.sector_code
WHERE op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    payer_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    payee_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account payer_acc ON pe.from_account_id = payer_acc.account_id
JOIN main.account payee_acc ON pe.to_account_id = payee_acc.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder payer_holder ON payer_acc.account_id = payer_holder.account_id AND payer_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.account_holder payee_holder ON payee_acc.account_id = payee_holder.account_id AND payee_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.party payer_party ON payer_holder.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN main.party payee_party ON payee_holder.party_id = payee_party.party_id
JOIN main.party_relation rel ON (rel.source_party_id = payer_party.party_id AND rel.target_party_id = payee_party.party_id)
    OR (rel.source_party_id = payee_party.party_id AND rel.target_party_id = payer_party.party_id)
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rel.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    t2.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(t1.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown t1
JOIN main.credit_agreement t3 ON t1.agreement_id = t3.agreement_id
JOIN main.party t2 ON t3.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
GROUP BY t1.agreement_id, t2.display_name
HAVING COUNT(t1.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(t1.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON acc.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    so.staff_id AS staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN main.account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.party p ON to_holder.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY so.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    t.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    t.event_date,
    t.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(t.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM main.customer_due_diligence_event_v3 t
JOIN main.institution i ON t.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE t.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    cl.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM
    main.collateral_link cl
JOIN
    main.collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN
    main.security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    cl.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rank_in_institution
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_in_institution
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rank_in_institution = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balance_latest AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_with_industry AS (
    SELECT
        lbl.loan_id,
        lbl.principal_balance,
        op.industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_latest lbl ON ld.loan_id = lbl.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN main.industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        sector_name_zh,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sector_name_zh ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) as rnk
    FROM loan_with_industry
)
SELECT
    sector_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rnk
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh ASC, rnk ASC;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM main.payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM main.security_agreement sa
INNER JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days > 360 THEN '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        WHEN principal_overdue_days > 360 THEN 5
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        WHEN principal_overdue_days > 360 THEN 5
    END ASC;

SELECT
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    main.collateral_valuation
GROUP BY
    collateral_id,
    valued_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,

    )

WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    avg_principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
JOIN main.staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN main.service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN main.payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS 客户数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS 平均年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.party_id), 6) AS 高收入客户占比
FROM
    main.party p
JOIN
    main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT a.institution_id FROM main.account a WHERE a.account_id = pe.from_account_id),
            (SELECT a.institution_id FROM main.account a WHERE a.account_id = pe.to_account_id)
        ) AS institution_id
    FROM main.payment_event pe
),
account_holders AS (
    SELECT
        pa.payment_id,
        pa.amount,
        pa.institution_id,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM main.account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pa.from_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' LIMIT 1) AS from_party_id,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM main.account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pa.to_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' LIMIT 1) AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_accounts pa
),
related_payments AS (
    SELECT
        ah.payment_id,
        ah.amount,
        ah.institution_id,
        ah.from_party_id,
        ah.to_party_id
    FROM account_holders ah
    WHERE ah.from_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ah.to_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM main.party_relation pr
          WHERE pr.source_party_id = ah.from_party_id
            AND pr.target_party_id = ah.to_party_id
            AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      )
),
institution_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) AS related_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(ah.amount), 0) AS total_amount
    FROM main.institution i
    LEFT JOIN related_payments rp ON i.institution_id = rp.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holders ah ON i.institution_id = ah.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    related_amount,
    total_amount,
    ROUND(related_amount * 1.0 / total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution_stats
WHERE total_amount > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM main.party p
INNER JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
INNER JOIN main.payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
INNER JOIN main.account a ON p.party_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN main.account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND p.party_id = ah.party_id
INNER JOIN main.term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balance_by_industry AS (
    SELECT
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
industry_totals AS (
    SELECT
        industry_code,
        total_principal_balance,
        SUM(total_principal_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM loan_balance_by_industry
),
industry_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        industry_code,
        total_principal_balance,
        SUM(total_principal_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(total_principal_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC) * 1.0 / grand_total AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM industry_totals
)
SELECT
    isc.industry_code,
    ROUND(isc.total_principal_balance, 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(isc.cumulative_ratio, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM industry_with_cumulative isc
WHERE isc.cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY isc.cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS unsettled_loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY borrower_party_id, i.institution_id
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY unsettled_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN main.collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM main.collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
AND cv.valuation_amount > 2.0 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM
    main.party p
JOIN
    main.account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN
    main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    from_account_id AS account_id,
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM

GROUP BY

    business_date
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY

LIMIT 20;

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,

JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'

GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC;

SELECT

HAVING

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT
    i.institution_name,

FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'

GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT

FROM main.loan_drawdown ld

JOIN main.payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id

SELECT

SELECT

    op.industry_code,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id

  AND op.industry_code IN (
      SELECT sector_code
      FROM main.industry_sector
      WHERE risk_category = 'EXIT'
  )
