ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2.0 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

WITH institution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT source_party_id
        FROM main.party_relation
        WHERE relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN institution_totals it ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_amounts nra ON i.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS loan_balance_sum,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND cs.net_capital > 0
GROUP BY inst.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS float_percentage
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10.0
ORDER BY float_percentage DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT risk_class.obligor_party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM
    main.risk_exposure risk_class
JOIN
    main.institution inst ON risk_class.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN
    main.capital_snapshot cap ON risk_class.institution_id = cap.institution_id
    AND cap.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE
    risk_class.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cap.net_capital > 0
    AND risk_class.gross_exposure / cap.net_capital > 0.10
GROUP BY
    inst.institution_name
ORDER BY
    over_limit_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        egm.exposure_group_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_exposure
    FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
          AND ca.institution_id = (
              SELECT eg.institution_id
              FROM main.exposure_group eg
              WHERE eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
          )
    )
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY egm.exposure_group_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM main.exposure_group eg
    JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
        AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure, 2) AS total_exposure,
    ROUND(gc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN main.exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = ge.exposure_group_id
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.exposure_group_id = ge.exposure_group_id
WHERE ge.total_exposure > gc.net_capital * 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id AS disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    main.payment_event pe ON ld.loan_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
    AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
ORDER BY
    days_interval ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_balance_latest AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 0) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_latest lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked_borrowers AS (
    SELECT
        be.institution_id,
        be.borrower_party_id,
        be.total_principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY be.institution_id ORDER BY be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON be.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    rb.exposure_ratio
FROM ranked_borrowers rb
JOIN institution i ON rb.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rb.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS tier
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    tier
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY tier ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        lb.principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown l
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lb ON l.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND l.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_institution_balance
    FROM loan_balances
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        i.institution_name,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / it.total_institution_balance, 2) AS proportion_percentage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lb.institution_id
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balances lb
    JOIN institution_totals it ON lb.institution_id = it.institution_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON lb.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    proportion_percentage
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 300
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, proportion_percentage DESC, loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    COALESCE(ls.overdue_principal, 0.0) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COALESCE(rs.overdue_count, 0) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        SUM(overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal
    FROM
        main.loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE
        as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY
        loan_id
) ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
    FROM
        main.repayment_schedule
    WHERE
        status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY
        loan_id
) rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND COALESCE(rs.overdue_count, 0) >= 2
ORDER BY
    overdue_installment_count DESC,
    overdue_principal_total DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT t1.party_id
FROM main.account_holder t1
JOIN main.account t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
JOIN main.term_deposit t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder t4 ON t1.party_id = t4.party_id
JOIN main.account t5 ON t4.account_id = t5.account_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement t6 ON t1.party_id = t6.borrower_party_id
WHERE t2.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND t5.account_kind = 'LOAN'
ORDER BY t1.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    s.person_party_id
FROM
    main.staff_member s
WHERE
    s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND s.person_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            ah.party_id
        FROM
            main.account_holder ah
    )
ORDER BY
    s.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM
    main.account a
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            pe.from_account_id
        FROM
            main.payment_event pe
        WHERE
            pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    )
ORDER BY
    a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    security_id,
    guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment
WHERE
    status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY
    guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS loan_term_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY loan_term_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1
        WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 AND julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') >= 0 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS association_count
FROM
    main.collateral_link cl
WHERE
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    association_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM main.collateral_valuation cv
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH RepaymentAccountLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id AS repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on ASC, loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM RepaymentAccountLoans
    WHERE loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs_balance - avail_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM main.account a
JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    card_type,
    issued_on
FROM
    main.payment_card
WHERE
    expires_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND card_type = 'DEBIT'
    AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    issued_on ASC,
    card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND ld.disbursed_amount > 0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY
    entrusted_payment_ratio ASC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_total_disbursement AS (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM
        main.loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY
        agreement_id
)
SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    ctd.total_disbursed_amount AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ctd.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    contract_total_disbursement ctd ON ld.agreement_id = ctd.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ctd.total_disbursed_amount > 90
ORDER BY
    ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS actual_raise_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
            WHERE rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
            AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_loans
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
    HAVING overdue_loans > 0 AND total_loans > overdue_loans
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bls.overdue_loans,
    bls.total_loans
FROM borrower_loan_stats bls
JOIN main.party p ON bls.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY bls.overdue_loans DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN main.party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id != pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lb.principal_balance > 10000000.0
ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    main.account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t1.security_type,
    t1.contract_amount,
    t2.display_name
FROM main.credit_agreement t1
JOIN main.party t2 ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t1.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND t1.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC, t1.agreement_id ASC;

WITH institution_product_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
borrower_relations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.source_party_id,
        pr.target_party_id
    FROM main.party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        br.source_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM borrower_relations br
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        br.target_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM borrower_relations br
),
filtered_agreements AS (
    SELECT
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.annual_interest_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    INNER JOIN related_borrowers rb ON ca.borrower_party_id = rb.borrower_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    fa.borrower_party_id AS borrower_id,
    fa.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    ipar.avg_rate AS institution_product_avg_rate,
    ROUND(fa.annual_interest_rate - ipar.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM filtered_agreements fa
INNER JOIN institution_product_avg_rate ipar
    ON fa.institution_id = ipar.institution_id
    AND fa.product_family = ipar.product_family
INNER JOIN main.party p ON fa.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE fa.annual_interest_rate < ipar.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM
    main.party_relation pr
JOIN
    main.relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM main.loan_drawdown ld1
        WHERE ld1.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM main.credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
        )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM main.loan_drawdown ld2
        WHERE ld2.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM main.credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        egm.exposure_group_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
          AND ca.institution_id = (
              SELECT eg.institution_id
              FROM main.exposure_group eg
              WHERE eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
          )
    )
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY egm.exposure_group_id
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM main.exposure_group eg
    JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
        AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    eg.group_name,
    glb.member_count,
    ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance, 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(gc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS balance_to_capital_ratio
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN group_loan_balance glb ON glb.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
  AND (glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY balance_to_capital_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event p
JOIN main.account acc_from ON p.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN main.account acc_to ON p.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder holder_from ON acc_from.account_id = holder_from.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder holder_to ON acc_to.account_id = holder_to.account_id
JOIN main.party payer ON holder_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN main.party payee ON holder_to.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN main.party_relation rel ON payer.party_id = rel.source_party_id AND payee.party_id = rel.target_party_id
WHERE rel.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM
    main.product_holding_snapshot
WHERE
    lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY
    product_id
ORDER BY
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lds.loan_id,
    lds.principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lds
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot ds ON lds.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lds.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lds.loan_id, lds.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lds.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.principal_overdue_party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.total_overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        party_id,
        SUM(overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM (
        SELECT
            lds.loan_id,
            ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
            lds.overdue_principal
        FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lds
        JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
          AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
    )
    GROUP BY loan_id, party_id
) lbs
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON lbs.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN main.exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
ORDER BY
    逾期本金合计 DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    gg.total_guarantee_amount AS 对外担保合计,
    bl.total_loan_amount AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(gg.total_guarantee_amount - bl.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN guarantor_guarantees gg ON p.party_id = gg.guarantor_party_id
JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND op.operating_status = 'OPERATING'
  AND gg.total_guarantee_amount > bl.total_loan_amount
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM
    staff_member sm
JOIN
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sm.staff_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = ld.agreement_id -- Note: loan_drawdown links to agreement, need to join agreement to get borrower
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
  AND p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY
    倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM
    staff_member sm
JOIN
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN
    staff_assignment sa ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
    AND sa.role_code = 'RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER'
    AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account acc ON ld.loan_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN main.party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_repayment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    pp.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY
    repayment_to_income_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_family AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND t.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING expired_count >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM main.account a
JOIN main.account_holder ah1 ON a.account_id = ah1.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah2 ON a.account_id = ah2.account_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE ah1.party_id != ah2.party_id
  AND a.account_id = ah1.account_id
  AND a.account_id = ah2.account_id
  AND ah1.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  AND ah2.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM
    main.repayment_schedule rs
WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY
    rs.loan_id
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) > 120000000.0
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0 END), 2) AS overdue_interest_sum
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING overdue_installment_count >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM
    main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    principal_due,
    interest_due
FROM
    repayment_schedule
WHERE
    status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY
    principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh
FROM
    main.credit_facility cf
JOIN
    main.status_catalog sc
ON
    cf.status = sc.status_code
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
ORDER BY
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM
    main.credit_facility cf
JOIN
    main.institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    cf.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000.0
ORDER BY
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    facility_type AS 授信类型,
    COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM
    credit_facility
WHERE
    limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY
    facility_type
ORDER BY
    记录数 DESC;

SELECT
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.payment_mode_catalog pm ON ld.payment_mode = pm.payment_mode
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM
        main.wealth_product
    WHERE
        status = 'ON_SALE'
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM
        ranked_products
    WHERE
        minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY
        group_id
)
SELECT
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM
    group_counts
WHERE
    product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY
    group_id ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'TERM'
  AND ca.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.drawdown_type IN (
      SELECT product_code
      FROM main.loan_product_catalog
      WHERE is_working_capital = 1
  )

SELECT
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM
    main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN
    main.payment_mode_catalog pm ON pi.payment_mode = pm.payment_mode
WHERE
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC;

SELECT
    itc.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM
    main.instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN
    main.status_catalog sc
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY
    itc.name_zh,
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
JOIN main.staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN main.staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN main.service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    staff_count DESC;

SELECT
    dlq.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    dlq.principal_overdue_days,
    dlq.overdue_principal
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot dlq
JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON dlq.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE dlq.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND dlq.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY dlq.principal_overdue_days DESC, dlq.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pv.provision_id) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM
    main.provision_snapshot pv
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON pv.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    pv.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND pv.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND pv.recognized_amount < 0.5 * pv.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    b.ledger_balance
FROM main.account a
JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT ah.account_id
      FROM main.account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    客户数量 DESC,
    客户分层 ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM main.managed_asset ma
JOIN main.industry_sector isec
    ON ma.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY
    debt_service_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    status AS 卡状态,
    COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM
    main.payment_card
WHERE
    card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY
    status
ORDER BY
    发卡数量 DESC,
    卡状态 ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON acc.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC,
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM
    main.payment_card
GROUP BY
    holder_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY
    发卡数量 DESC,
    持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT
    ct.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN main.card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ct.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM
    main.payment_event
WHERE
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY
    channel
HAVING
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) > 11780000.0
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.maturity_on,
    a.status AS account_status
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM
    main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN
    main.collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label
HAVING
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS collateral_ref_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM main.collateral_link cl
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY collateral_ref_count DESC, cl.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
guarantor_details AS (
    SELECT
        gc.commitment_id,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        gc.status AS guarantee_status,
        so.agreement_id,
        lt.total_disbursed_amount
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON so.agreement_id = lt.agreement_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
    gd.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gd.agreement_id,
    ROUND(gd.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(gd.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_details gd
JOIN main.party p ON gd.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gd.guaranteed_amount > gd.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY gd.guaranteed_amount DESC, gd.guarantor_party_id ASC, gd.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0.0) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0.0) AS 保障缺口
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN main.secured_obligation so
    ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
    AND so.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0.0)
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, 授信合同编号 ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count
FROM
    main.provision_snapshot ls
JOIN
    main.risk_classification rc ON ls.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND ls.recognized_amount < ls.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 贷款余额,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 0
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4.0 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.recognized_amount - p.required_amount), 2) AS over_provision_amount
FROM
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    main.risk_classification rc ON p.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND p.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND p.recognized_amount > p.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY
    over_provision_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_value
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_value
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(em.max_external_value, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value, 2) AS difference
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_max im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
JOIN external_max em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.max_internal_value > em.max_external_value
ORDER BY difference DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valued_on DESC) as rn
    FROM main.collateral_valuation cv
),
effective_pledges AS (
    SELECT
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) as total_pledged_amount
    FROM main.collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    lv.valuation_amount,
    ep.total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(ep.total_pledged_amount - lv.valuation_amount, 2) as coverage_gap
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON ca.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
JOIN effective_pledges ep ON ca.collateral_id = ep.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount < ep.total_pledged_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_borrow_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_commitments AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.total_borrow_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gc.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM main.party p
JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitments gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.total_guarantee_amount > bl.total_borrow_amount
ORDER BY gc.total_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000.0
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh AS exposure_group_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.exposure_group_type_catalog egt ON eg.group_type = egt.group_type
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, eg.group_type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT
    egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS "主体编号",
    p.display_name AS "主体名称",
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS "关联关系条数",
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS "借款合同笔数"
FROM party p
INNER JOIN party_relation pr
    ON p.party_id IN (pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    "关联关系条数" DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
INNER JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
INNER JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

WITH party_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM party p
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY p.party_id
),
related_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.relation_id,
        pr.source_party_id,
        pr.target_party_id,
        COALESCE(slc.loan_count, 0) AS source_loan_count,
        COALESCE(tlc.loan_count, 0) AS target_loan_count
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    LEFT JOIN party_loan_counts slc ON pr.source_party_id = slc.party_id
    LEFT JOIN party_loan_counts tlc ON pr.target_party_id = tlc.party_id
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
      AND slc.loan_count > 0
      AND tlc.loan_count > 0
)
SELECT 
    relation_id,
    source_party_id,
    target_party_id,
    source_loan_count,
    target_loan_count
FROM related_parties
ORDER BY (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    c.collateral_type
FROM
    main.collateral_asset c
WHERE
    c.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND c.collateral_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            cl.collateral_id
        FROM
            main.collateral_link cl
        WHERE
            cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
ORDER BY
    c.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_effective_guarantee AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_effective_guarantee
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_loan_exposure
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_with_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        geg.guarantor_party_id,
        geg.total_effective_guarantee,
        COALESCE(ble.total_loan_exposure, 0) AS total_loan_exposure
    FROM guarantor_effective_guarantee geg
    LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_exposure ble ON geg.guarantor_party_id = ble.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    gwe.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(gwe.total_effective_guarantee, 2) AS total_effective_guarantee,
    ROUND(gwe.total_loan_exposure, 2) AS total_loan_exposure,
    ROUND(gwe.total_effective_guarantee - gwe.total_loan_exposure, 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_with_exposure gwe
JOIN main.party p ON gwe.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gwe.total_effective_guarantee > gwe.total_loan_exposure
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS "保证人编号",
    p.display_name AS "保证人名称",
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS "保证金额",
    gc.status AS "保证状态"
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
      WHERE ld.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
)
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE wp.issuer_institution_id = (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM main.institution
    LIMIT 1
)
AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS 关联抵押物笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人笔数
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inverted_amount_sum,
    COUNT(phs.holding_id) AS inverted_holding_count
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inverted_amount_sum DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(overdue_borrower.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN main.wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.owner_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM main.collateral_asset ca
    JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON 1=1 -- This join is incorrect logic for finding borrower with overdue loans.
    -- Let's re-evaluate: "底层资产发行人为本行存在逾期借据的借款人"
    -- 1. Find borrowers (obligor_party_id in managed_asset) who have overdue loans in the same institution.
    -- 2. The "issuer" of the underlying asset is ma.obligor_party_id.
    -- 3. Check if ma.obligor_party_id has overdue loans in the institution issuing the wealth product (wp.issuer_institution_id).
    
    -- Step 1: Identify obligors with overdue loans per institution
    SELECT
        cd.obligor_party_id,
        cd.institution_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM main.loan_drawdown cd
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON cd.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY cd.obligor_party_id, cd.institution_id
) overdue_borrower ON ma.obligor_party_id = overdue_borrower.obligor_party_id
                   AND wp.issuer_institution_id = overdue_borrower.institution_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_pledge_ratio_count
FROM main.collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY high_pledge_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM
    main.institution i
JOIN
    main.financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM
    main.institution i
JOIN
    main.financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    asset_liability_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.tier1_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM
    main.capital_snapshot c
JOIN
    main.institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY
    core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(fs.annual_revenue) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM main.financial_snapshot fs
JOIN main.institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(fs.annual_revenue) OVER (), 2) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_rating_count
FROM main.managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_rating_count DESC;

SELECT
    valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot
GROUP BY valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(t.account_id) AS count,
    ROUND(SUM(t.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(t.account_id) AS certificate_count
FROM
    main.term_deposit t
JOIN
    main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    t.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    certificate_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM main.service_operator so
JOIN main.staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(t.account_id) AS cnt
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE t.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND t.maturity_on <= '2026-07-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

WITH loan_provision_diff AS (
    SELECT
        ld.institution_id,
        SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY ld.institution_id
),
institution_financials AS (
    SELECT
        fs.party_id,
        fs.net_assets
    FROM main.financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
result AS (
    SELECT
        inst.institution_id,
        inst.institution_name,
        lp.under_provision_total,
        IFNULL(ifs.net_assets, 0) AS net_assets,
        ROUND(lp.under_provision_total * 1.0 / IFNULL(ifs.net_assets, 0), 2) AS under_provision_ratio
    FROM loan_provision_diff lp
    JOIN main.institution inst ON lp.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution_financials ifs ON ifs.party_id = 'PTY-' || lp.institution_id
    WHERE lp.under_provision_total > 0
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    institution_name,
    under_provision_total,
    net_assets,
    under_provision_ratio
FROM result
WHERE under_provision_ratio > 0 OR net_assets = 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE
    rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING
    COUNT(rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY
    借据数量 DESC,
    风险分类名称 ASC;

WITH bad_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ls.principal_overdue_days >= 90
      AND rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS')
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        fs.party_id,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM main.financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        bls.institution_id,
        bls.bad_loan_count,
        bls.total_overdue_principal,
        ir.annual_revenue,
        ROUND(bls.total_overdue_principal * 1.0 / ir.annual_revenue, 6) AS overdue_ratio
    FROM bad_loan_stats bls
    JOIN institution_revenue ir ON ir.party_id = 'PTY-' || bls.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    bad_loan_count,
    total_overdue_principal
FROM combined
WHERE overdue_ratio > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_total,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE ld.status != 'SETTLED'
  AND ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pr.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    fs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM main.prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pr
JOIN main.institution i ON pr.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE pr.exception_flag = 1
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pr.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

WITH provision_deficit AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pds.loan_id) AS deficit_loan_count,
        SUM(pds.required_amount - pds.recognized_amount) AS deficit_amount
    FROM main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
    JOIN main.provision_snapshot pds ON rse.subject_id = pds.loan_id
    WHERE rse.event_code = 'submission_001' 
      AND rse.exception_flag = 1
      AND pds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND pds.recognized_amount < pds.required_amount
    GROUP BY ra.institution_id
),
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT 
        rse.institution_id,
        COUNT(rse.record_id) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
    WHERE rse.event_code = 'submission_001' 
      AND rse.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY rse.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(rse.record_id) >= 25
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_record_count,
    ro.avg_amount,
    COALESCE(pd.deficit_loan_count, 0) AS deficit_loan_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(pd.deficit_amount, 0), 2) AS deficit_amount
FROM main.institution i
JOIN regulatory_overdue ro ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_deficit pd ON i.institution_id = pd.institution_id
ORDER BY deficit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gcv3.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(gcv3.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM main.institution i
LEFT JOIN main.credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.governance_control_record_v3 gcv3 ON i.institution_id = gcv3.institution_id
    AND gcv3.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN gcv3.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount_sum DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非“非关联方”关系笔数
FROM main.ai_system_record_v3 ai
JOIN main.party p ON ai.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.party_relation pr ON ai.subject_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN main.relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE ai.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS unique_cardholder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS op_risk_valid_record_count
FROM main.institution i
LEFT JOIN main.payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM main.account a
        WHERE a.institution_id = i.institution_id
          AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN main.operational_risk_event_v3 ore
    ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY op_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(v3.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(v3.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.wealth_product wp
    ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
JOIN main.ai_system_record_v3 v3
    ON i.institution_id = v3.institution_id
    AND v3.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(v3.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v3.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS custody_active_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN v3.exception_flag = 1 THEN v3.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
FROM main.institution inst
LEFT JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.custody_operation_event_v3 v3 ON v3.institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_id, inst.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN v3.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND v3.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, inst.institution_name ASC;
